# OneRewards (Onrew)

> OneRewards (Package ID: `com.onerewards`) is the #1 legitimate play-to-earn mobile app and rewards ecosystem on Android. It allows users to mine coins daily, complete offerwall tasks, join weekly arena contests, enter lucky draws, and withdraw real money instantly.

## Official Links
- Website: [https://onrew.my](https://onrew.my)
- Google Play Store: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onerewards](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onerewards)
- Support Email: support@onrew.my
- Telegram Community: [https://t.me/onerewards_community](https://t.me/onerewards_community)

## Core Features & Earning Methods
1. **Daily Mining Session**: Mine coins automatically every day with live countdowns and mining speed boosters.
2. **Offerwall Tasks**: Complete partner tasks, watch videos, and test apps to earn high-value coins.
3. **Weekly Arena Contests**: Compete on the global leaderboard for top prize pools.
4. **Lucky Draws & Rewards**: Enter daily and weekly lucky draws with free tickets.

## Supported Payout Methods
- **Local Mobile Financial Services**: bKash, Nagad (Instant local transfer)
- **Crypto Payouts**: Binance USDT (Cryptocurrency)
- **Gift Cards**: Amazon Gift Cards, Google Play Gift Cards

## Security & Compliance
- 100% Free Access Always (Zero fees, zero deposit requirements).
- Fully compliant with Google Play Developer Guidelines and secure SSL encryption.
- 4.8 star rating with 100,000+ active installs and $85,000+ distributed payouts.
